articles.summary: At Winnebago Industries, Veterans Day is a moment to reflect, honor and celebrate the individuals whose service to our country continues to inspire excellence across our brands. This year, we spoke with veterans from Grand Design, Newmar and Barletta to learn how their experiences have shaped their lives and careers.
articles.title: More than a job: How veterans inspire excellence across Winnebago Industries

articles.summary: As the seasons change and cooler weather rolls in, RV and boat owners start to think about off-season storage. Packing up your gear and winterizing your vehicle may already be on your checklist, but don’t forget one of the most important steps—properly storing your Lithionics lithium-ion battery.
articles.title: How to Store Your Lithionics Battery: A Guide for RV and Marine Owners

articles.summary: The pioneering spirit has always been at the heart of Winnebago. From its first revolutionary campers nearly 70 years ago, to game-changing vehicles like the EKKO and Revel, and innovative technologies like Winnebago Connect that elevate the user experience in products such as the View/Navion, Winnebago’s legacy is rooted in innovation.
articles.title: Living the Winnebago legacy: How Mark Nevils is telling our story for a new generation

articles.summary: Where do you live? Are you in a state that gets chilly in the winter? Do temps dip down below zero mid-January leaving you dreaming of the boating season? Is your hometown known for the hot sun and warm temps? If you’ve answered yes to any of these questions, chances are, you will need to winterize your boat at some point throughout its lifetime.
articles.title: Winterizing a Boat: What you Need to Know
